# Completed Work

Completed work in chronological order, based on the date each work document was committed.

| Date | Work | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-10-05 | [Scaffold Project Foundation](scaffold-project-foundation.md) | Established the empty project foundation: skeletons for the integration, the SAJ library sub-package, the standalone Modbus mock service and the Lovelace frontend. Added lint, type, import-isolation and 100 percent coverage gates, both Playwright tiers, the Docker development environment, make targets and the CI workflow. |
| 2026-10-06 | [Build SAJ Modbus Mock Simulator](build-saj-modbus-mock-simulator.md) | Implemented standalone HS3 and H2 Modbus TCP simulators with deterministic power flows, writable controls and configurable equipment scenarios. Added container healthchecks, scenario smoke tests and module-level unit coverage. |
| 2026-10-06 | [Rename Integration To SAJ Local](rename-integration-to-saj-local.md) | Authorised renaming the integration domain to `saj_local` and display name to SAJ Local to avoid conflicts with other integrations. Covers frontend identifiers, tooling, tests and current documentation. |
| 2026-10-07 | [Add H2 Support With Shared Device Profiles](add-h2-support-with-shared-device-profiles.md) | Replaced the HS3-specific library code with model-neutral device profiles so the H2 and HS3 share one implementation, with automatic model detection, a verified manual override and replacement between models that keeps entities and history. Reduced the browser tier to load-and-function smoke for both models. |
| 2026-10-08 | [Add Polling Groups With Per-Sensor Cadence](add-polling-groups-with-per-sensor-cadence.md) | Added named polling groups as config subentries so selected sensors are read faster or slower than the default interval, on one shared schedule in the SAJ library. Added device protection for communication modules: a per-endpoint request budget and failure back-off that survive reloads, bounded cycles, late-frame handling, and isolation and suspension of refused registers. |
| 2026-10-08 | [Add Configurable Entity ID Prefix](add-configurable-entity-id-prefix.md) | Fixed sensor entity IDs to `sensor.saj_<key>`, built from the sensor key instead of display text, with an optional unique per-installation prefix so several systems never get `_2` IDs. A prefix can be added, changed or removed in Configure after a confirmation; entities are renamed through the entity registry so history and statistics follow. |
| 2026-10-10 | [Add Register Catalogue With Full Sensor Coverage](add-register-catalogue-with-full-sensor-coverage.md) | Replaced the six fixed sensors with a register catalogue of shared key definitions and one data file per model, exposing every known HS3 and H2 register as sensor, number, select, switch, time and text entities, with a small core set enabled by default and controls that refuse changes until writes exist. Added read planning that bridges gaps inside documented blocks within each model's request size, refusal narrowing by halving, registers that are never read, and the request load shown in the polling-group and Configure forms. |
| 2026-10-10 | [Add Opt-In Register Writes](add-opt-in-register-writes.md) | Added an Allow control option per installation, off by default and confirmed when switched on, after which settings are written once, read back and shown as the inverter holds them, with commissioning settings kept read-only and a write allowance of 20 requests a minute. Added command buttons and the HS3 EMS targets and limits, with a heartbeat that reads the target of each function Home Assistant switched on and a switch-off of those functions on unload and stop. |
| 2026-10-11 | [Add Optional Equipment Detection](add-optional-equipment-detection.md) | Detects the battery, Meter A, Meter B, EV charger and parallel system at every setup and creates, reads and writes only the entities of equipment that is fitted, with an Automatic, Fitted or Not fitted setting per item in Configure; detected equipment is remembered and a lapse raises a repair issue. Added EMS control of the EV charger, the parallel block and its own battery protocol options on H2, battery-pack entities limited by the pack count, and default-enabled main entities for detected equipment. |
| 2026-10-12 | [Add Model-Neutral Power Control With Schedules](add-model-neutral-power-control-with-schedules.md) | Added a model-neutral power control layer: a switch and a watt target per function (Battery, Grid, Inverter) with the same keys on every model, done through the EMS enable bits on the HS3 and passive mode on the H2, each stated in its model file. A function can follow a native Home Assistant schedule helper attached to the system as a separate addition, like a polling group. |
| 2026-10-13 | [Add Device Faults And Repairs](add-device-faults-and-repairs.md) | Added a fault binary sensor per named fault, plus a summary and an unrecognised-fault sensor, for the inverter, the battery and its packs, and the EV charger. Each fault uses one model-neutral key, and each model maps its own register bits to it. Added Home Assistant repairs for a wrong model, a changed serial or an unrecognised device (the first two adopt the device through the Configure path), refused registers (the fix disables them) and an endpoint that stops answering. A device check now closes the connection it borrowed, so the next poll re-checks identity. |
| 2026-10-13 | [Add Debug Dump And Logging](add-debug-dump-and-logging.md) | Added a raw register snapshot to the diagnostics download: the latest words of every register read, including registers that are not entities, plus every failed request and why, with private rows and the serial redacted and no extra Modbus requests. Every log line now names its system with the serial masked, and Home Assistant's debug logging gives one line per poll, connection change, write and EMS beat. |
| 2026-10-15 | [Add Full H2 Support](add-full-h2-support.md) | Catalogued every setting and reading the H2 has, with the buzzer, LED ring and battery forced charge power writable and every commissioning setting read-only, peak shaving as an application mode, battery voltage and current enabled by default, and the identity of up to five battery packs with private serials. The H2 grid totals now come from the all-phase counters as on the HS3, the simulator can run an H2 with a parallel system, a Meter B or five packs, and the README states why the H2 has no Grid or Inverter power control. |
| 2026-10-16 | [Add Simulator Control Panel](add-simulator-control-panel.md) | Added a web page to each running simulator that changes it without editing its scenario or restarting it: every writable setting with named values, every fault bit the model reports with the effects real faults have, the shape and seed of the random variation, holds on PV, load, grid voltage and frequency, the state of charge, the car, the clock and the energy counters. Changes are kept across restarts, with presets, a reset to the scenario and export as a scenario. |
| 2026-10-16 | [Redesign Simulator Panel With Inspector And Link Faults](redesign-simulator-panel-with-inspector-and-link-faults.md) | Rebuilt the simulator page into views with a status bar showing what differs from the scenario, a power-flow diagram above one card per piece of equipment with its own reset, a searchable fault catalogue, a register inspector of every raw and decoded value with when a client last read it, and a traffic log of every connection and request with counters, rates and a graph per client. The simulated communication module can now misbehave as field reports describe, with latency, missing, busy and non-standard answers, refused blocks, dropped connections, late duplicates, offline and unresponsive modules and a lockout, set in a `link` scenario section, on the page or by preset and deterministic for a seed. |
| 2026-10-18 | [Add Lovelace Cards](add-lovelace-cards-and-system-dashboard.md) | Added six SAJ Local cards (power flow, status, faults, battery, controls and schedules), a weekday-button tile card feature and a status badge, served by the integration with no resource to add, each set up by choosing a system and drawing only what that system has, in the user's theme and language. Added a `control_allowed` sensor per system, and switching Allow control on now enables the system's controls with the added request load shown in the warning; the development environment has YAML showcase dashboards with every element written out individually. |
| 2026-10-20 | [Trim Check Output For Agents](trim-check-output-for-agents.md) | Every make target now runs through a check runner that prints one line per step, the `file:line` findings of a failing step and a final result line, runs every step even after one fails, reports timeouts and kills as such, stops the whole tool on Ctrl-C and lists or describes every target with `make help`; each tool is quiet in its own configuration, with `V=1` for raw output. `make ci` gains a per-module coverage gate and hassfest, GitHub runs `make ci` itself in one job, the tests move into six named folders, and the repair texts hassfest rejected move into the fix-flow confirm steps. |
| 2026-10-21 | [Rename Mock And Clone To SAJ Local](rename-mock-and-clone-to-saj-local.md) | Every name the project owns now follows `saj_local`: the simulator is the package `saj_local_mock` in `mock/`, run as the compose services `mock` and `mock-h2` in the fixed compose project `ha-saj-local`, and the repository is `Counterphase-Labs/ha-saj-local`. Simulator state is kept in bind-mounted, git-ignored folders under `mock/state/`, so renaming the clone folder no longer strands it, and the smoke run checks that both simulators save. |
| 2026-10-22 | [Freeze Review Of Entities And Stored Settings](freeze-review-of-entities-and-stored-settings.md) | Reviewed every entity key, identifier, stored setting, card type and card setting before the first release and fixed the names, units, signs, categories and defaults found wrong, so the release starts from a surface that can stay fixed. `make ci` gains a `freeze-check` step that, once a release tag exists, fails any change removing or altering an entity, stored setting or card setting, and `AGENTS.md` requires a version rise with a migration for every stored-form change after release. |
| 2026-10-23 | [Add Feature Lists And Part Requirements](add-feature-lists-and-part-requirements.md) | The integration, the cards and the simulator each have a plain-language `docs/features.md` of what they do today, written from the code, and a `docs/requirements.md` holding the requirements that concern them, moved byte for byte from `.github/work/requirements.md`, which now holds only the requirements that span parts. Matching sections link both ways, each part has its own `AGENTS.md` that keeps its feature list current, and the README and development guide now use the card option and element names the code uses. |
| 2026-10-23 | [Add User And Developer Documentation](add-user-and-developer-documentation.md) | SAJ Local has user and developer documentation under `docs/en-gb/`, with an entity reference generated from the catalogue and screenshots of Home Assistant and of every view of the simulator page, all made by `make docs-images`; the README is a short pitch and the developer index puts the simulator first. `make ci` gains `docs-check`, which fails on a stale entity reference, a broken link or anchor, an orphan image, an oversized page or a feature list section no page covers. |
| 2026-10-23 | [Add Security Policy And Issue Templates](add-security-policy-and-issue-templates.md) | `SECURITY.md` tells users how to report a security problem privately and what happens next, and the issue forms ask for what a maintainer needs: the integration bug report requires the diagnostics download, and card bugs and other issues have forms of their own. The repository labels live in `.github/labels.yml` and are synced by a workflow, and `make ci` gains `template-check`, which fails when an issue form stops requiring the diagnostics download, names a missing label or lists models other than the supported ones. |
| 2026-10-25 | [Add Release Workflow And Versioning](add-release-workflow-and-versioning.md) | Pushing a version tag on `main` runs `make ci` on the tagged commit and creates a draft GitHub release with generated notes, marked as a pre-release for a beta such as `1.0.0b1`, which HACS offers to users who turn on "Show beta versions". `release-check` fails when the versions in `manifest.json`, `pyproject.toml` and `frontend/package.json` differ, are not `X.Y.Z` or `X.Y.ZbN`, or differ from the tag, and `freeze-check` compares only with the newest stable release, so a beta never freezes the surface. |
| 2026-10-26 | [Reduce Make CI Time](reduce-make-ci-time.md) | `make ci` runs every check in about 250 s instead of about 471 s: one context-tracked coverage run feeds both the total gate and the per-module gate that used 90 separate pytest runs, the tests that do not need Home Assistant run without its pytest plugin, and the browser and smoke steps reuse the built card bundle and one `saj-local-mock` image. `test-python` also fails any unit test whose body takes over 200 ms in the coverage run, and the slowest tests were rewritten. |
| 2026-10-27 | [Add Target Language Translations](add-target-language-translations.md) | SAJ Local, its cards and its documentation are available in German, Dutch, French, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Italian, Polish and Swedish as well as English: entity names, the setup and options forms, repairs, the card texts, every documentation page, the screenshots and a translated README with translated badges. Every page starts with a language bar linking the same page in each language, written by `make docs` and checked by `make docs-check`, which also fails when a language has no translation file, no generator texts, no translated README or an entity without a name. |
| 2026-10-28 | [Fix jscpd Prefixed Clone Parsing](fix-jscpd-prefixed-clone-parsing.md) | `make copy-paste` names every duplicated block with both locations even when jscpd prints the shared folder as a prefix or tags a same-file clone with the format of an embedded block, instead of reporting a bare "failed" with the raw jscpd output. uv warnings no longer appear in the step's output. |
| 2026-11-04 | [Rectify HS3 Live Test Findings](rectify-hs3-live-test-findings.md) | On an HS3, Grid power now shows the real grid exchange from Meter A and Household load power the real house load from the on-grid output phases, and the EV charger readings have values because SAJ Local reads them as input registers (function code 04). Diagnostics and debug logs name the function code of each request, and the simulator serves the HS3 registers as the real unit does. |
| 2026-11-07 | [Keep Unchanged Documentation Screenshots](keep-unchanged-documentation-screenshots.md) | A second `make docs-images` run with no interface change leaves the screenshots unchanged in git: the docs simulators run with stopped clocks, and the simulator page, repair and equipment screenshots show fixed timing values and a fully open section. The languages run at the same time with a result and report folder each, and the Playwright containers run as the host user, so no run leaves root-owned files. |
| 2026-11-10 | [Add Derived Battery And Energy Sensors](add-derived-battery-and-energy-sensors.md) | Each system with a battery shows the time until the battery is full or empty, from battery power averaged over 10 minutes, and the energy stored and still available in the battery. The H2 uses its usable capacity and the HS3 learns its capacity and keeps it across restarts. Self-sufficiency today, self-consumption today, solar surplus power and battery round-trip efficiency are added as disabled sensors, and the battery card shows the time row. |
